memos.scout:
The honest case for buying "Agency" now is thin, and I'd lean toward skipping.

What supports demand: the coin is alive at 30.8 minutes and has returned about 6.8x over that window. It is classed ORGANIC (no airdrop dump seen), the curve shows 229 buyers with a modest top-3 share (12%), and the last 15 minutes carried about $730K volume across 2,149 buyers with positive net flow of 172 SOL. Graduation came in 170 seconds, and the completer share is 30%, not extreme.

What argues against: it is already 47% below its 30-minute high, so the rally has stalled and reversed. In the last 15 minutes, sell volume (3,010 SOL) nearly matched buy volume (3,183 SOL), with 1,529 sellers against 2,149 buyers. Early post-graduation sell-to-buy ratio was 0.90, and a launch bot was present. The bundle share of 25% suggests coordinated early buying. Net flow over the last 15 minutes is small relative to gross volume, which points to churn, not accumulation.

Nothing here shows demand that will hold for the next 30 to 60 minutes. A round trip costs 1.4 to 5.1% on a $20 ticket, and the base rate for a random buy in this window is roughly a 20% loss. I'd recommend passing.
